name: Aidan Guernsey
bio: I am a Junior Computer Science major and Classical Studies minor, and am serving my second term as Music Director of Soul2Soul A Cappella! I have been singing since I was in pre-school, and in a cappella groups since middle school! Soul2Soul is a group of my best friends, and has made my time at Miami so much better. I love the a cappella community and am so excited to see what the next year and a half has in store!
solos: Bruno Mars Medley (Just the Way You Are)
funFact: I attended Camp A Cappella at Wright State University in middle school!
favoriteMemory: S2S formal at Lake Norris freshman year!

name: Wes Payne
bio: Wes joined Soul2Soul in the spring of 2021, his second semester at Miami. His experiences as a student leader, both in Soul2Soul and elsewhere, led him to pursuing and completing his M.A. in Higher Education/Student Affairs from The Ohio State University in May 2026. Wes currently works at Northwestern University as a Program Coordinator for Residential and Academic Engagement, where he supports student leadership development and peer-to-peer programming for the student leaders living on campus. Wes loves cooking, trying new restaurants, sports, music, movies, and video games.
solos:
Evolution of Muse - Madness
Misery
Drops of Jupiter
funFact: My favorite recipe to make is chicken parm!
favoriteMemory: Recording our album during Winter Break in 2022!

name: Aaron Chavez
major: Liberal Studies - Education, Health and Society
job: Academic Advisor - Mercy College of Ohio, Higher Education
bio: I’ve been singing in choir since the 3rd grade, so you could say vocal performance has been integral to me for quite some time. When I came to Miami in 2020, I knew I wanted to be involved in some type of performance group. When I joined Soul2Soul in Fall 2021, I did not know I would meet my future best friends and brothers for life. Joining this group was life-saving and I would not trade it for the world. By day, I work as an Academic Advisor; also by day (and long nights), I arrange a cappella scores and stack vocals and harmonies until my computer runs out of storage. I love what Soul2Soul represents and am so happy to have long-lasting friendships and connections with my brothers in song.
solos: O Come All Ye Faithful (Samuel Ljungblahd)
One Of These Nights / Heartache Tonight (Eagles Medley)
funFact: I have arranged for four Miami A Cappella groups! (Soul2Soul, MU Trebz, Misfitz and Just Duet)!
favoriteArrangement: Before It's Too Late, Misnomer, Evergreen (can't choose one!)
favoriteMemory: Performing for the Miami Arts Series at the Columbus Art Museum!

name: James Boyle
bio: James Boyle is Junior Physics major and mathematics minor, and is serving his second year as Treasurer. He’s been singing since middle school and Soul2Soul is one of the best communities he has ever been a part of. Every member of this group is a good friend and he is excited to see what the rest of his time in Soul2Soul has in store!
funFact: He is also on SketchedOut, the Miami Improv team!
favoriteMemory: Going to Lake Norris, Tennessee during freshman year formal

name: Colby Beck
bio: Colby is currently a sophomore Psychology major, Sports Management minor. He is from Columbus, OH, and currently serve as the Business Director of Soul2Soul A Cappella! Colby has been singing all his life and was so excited to continue his passion here at Miami! Soul2Soul are truly Colby’s best friends and he always loves to hang out with them outside of all the rehearsals, gigs, and performances!
funFact: Colby’s first time leaving the country was a trip to South Africa
favoriteMemory: Our first alumni reunion in May 2026, it was awesome to meet so many alumni and hear their stories

name: Hunter Bolton
major: Business Econ and a Fashion co-major
bio: Hunter is a business student, painter, and aspiring model. He first became a part of Soul2Soul with no prior music experience but an eagerness to learn and has grown into a solid lower split bass with Jerod’s guidance. Coming into college, he had no idea he would be singing but a cappella has quickly become an integral part of his college experience and he is always looking to improve and help others.
funFact: I did my first magazine shoot this fall semester
favoriteArrangement: Either gorillaz medely or Jerod’s senior song

name: Liam Moore
major: Urban and Regional Planning and Co-Major in Sustainability
bio: Liam is a sophomore Urban Planning and Sustainability major at Miami University. He has been in A Capella since his sophomore year in high school and has sung all his life. Soul2Soul is a part of the backbone of his college life, and he loves the community A Cappella brings!
funFact: My hometown high school hosts a major A Cappella festival, bringing in high school groups from all over the country, and hosts a professional A Cappella group!

name: Henry Chesterton
bio: Henry is a freshman Business major at Miami University and a Tenor 2 in Soul2Soul A Cappella! He has been singing his entire life, starting with his first music class at just two years old alongside his mom. Although he has only been a member of Soul2Soul for one semester, he has already made great friendships and memories with the group. He is excited to continue growing as a singer and making the most of his next few years with Soul2Soul!
funFact: I sang bass in high school.
favoriteMemory: Getting the call that I got into soul2soul

name: Aydin Davis "AD" Wilhelm
bio: AD is in his second semester as Assistant Music Director of Soul2Soul A Cappella. A musician for 12 years, he spent most of them as a double bassist before turning to voice two years ago. After hearing about Soul2Soul through the Miami University Glee Club, he auditioned on a whim, driven mostly by a desire to improve his singing. Stepping outside his comfort zone led to one of his best adventures and lifelong friends.
funFact: I read Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows in one day!

name: Christopher Barger
job: I'm a writer and voice actor for cartoons and video games!
bio:
Christopher Barger is a graduate of Miami University and was one of the original members of Soul2Soul. He grew up outside of Cincinnati, Ohio and was always singing in some kind of school choir from age 12 up until graduating from Miami in 2014. Following graduation, he moved to Los Angeles in 2015 to work in entertainment. After years of assistant jobs and working at a production company reception desk, he wrote two episodes for the Netflix series 'Samurai Rabbit: The Usagi Chronicles' before being cast as Archangel, the winged blue member of the X-Force in Marvel Animation's X-Men '97 on Disney+.

He's beyond excited Soul2Soul is continuing the tradition of a cappella excellence, and can't wait to hear what comes next.
funFact: Emily Dickinson is my cousin. Seriously.
favoriteArrangement: The cover of 'As' by Stevie Wonder was something really special.
favoriteMemory: Getting to record that very first Soul2Soul album was a blast. I think back to those couple days rotating in-and-out of that recording booth with everyone very, very fondly.

name: James 'Jimmy' Tolbert
bio: Jimmy is a Sophomore Media and Communications and Film Studies co-major, and an Arts Management and Entrepreneurship minor. He has been singing in choirs since middle school, but only started a cappella at Miami. Soul2Soul has become a group of some of his closest friends and has made his time at Miami even better. He loves being apart a cappella community and is so excited for the continuing lifetime friendships to be made at Soul2Soul!
funFact: Jimmy's favorite films are Mulholland Drive, La La Land, Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind, The Nice Guys, and Sunset Boulevard
favoriteMemory: The spring Soul2Soul formal trip to Lake Norris, Tennessee, in 2026

name: Jack Danko
bio: Jack Danko is a third year Data Analytics major with a sports concentration, and a Theatre Minor. He is currently the group’s Director of Brotherhood and previously served as the Assistant Social Chair. Outside of Soul2Soul, Jack is apart of the Phi Kappa Tau fraternity in which he serves as the Social Committee’s Event Manager, and is apart of several other committees. He is also a model for MUF&D, and is apart of the Scene Shop crew for the Theatre Department at Miami, helping build sets. In his free time, he enjoys lifting, playing basketball or soccer, and spending time with his friends in any way he can. He loves the a cappella community and is excited to see what Soul2Soul can do during the rest of his time in the group!
funFact: I was in Shooting Stars (2023) and Superman (2025) as an extra.
